name: Alexa Saito
source:
Another student, Alexa is Daddy's little girl, but Daddy spends to much time
away working. She's smart, cunning and ambitious. She's studying physics
because her parents want her to be an engineer like her father, but she
wants to do her own thing, and college is just the place for her to figure out
exactly what (or who) that is. What Alexa wants, Alexa gets.

[From [url=https://raceoflifegame.com]Official Site[/url]]
